Package org.unitseek.knitid.core.api

Interface IdGenerator

All Known Subinterfaces:
NumericIdGenerator
All Known Implementing Classes:
BizIdGenerator, KsidGenerator, KsuidGenerator, TypeIdGenerator, UlidGenerator, Uuid7Generator, Uuid8Generator
public interface IdGenerator
Unified identifier generator contract.

Implementations must be thread-safe. Some implementations may block (for example KSID with the WAIT clock-backwards strategy); such behaviour must be documented by the implementation.

Since:
1.0.0

    • generateStream

      default Stream<String> generateStream(int size)
      Returns a lazy sequential stream of identifiers.

      The batch limit is checked before the stream is returned. Generation happens when the stream is consumed.

      Parameters:
      size - number of identifiers
      Returns:
      lazy identifier stream
      Since:
